anatomy.diffuse_multi_loop: multiple positive loops and leader share <= 0.50
anatomy.extreme_loop_dominance: multiple positive loops and leader share > 0.80
anatomy.loop_specific_threshold: positive loop-excess contribution > 50% of target supported positive payoff and fewer than half of same-regime peers are positive
anatomy.majority_loop_dominance: multiple positive loops and 0.50 < leader share <= 0.80
anatomy.multi_regime_shared: at least two positive regimes and common component > 0 in every supported episode session
anatomy.sequence_interaction_candidate: both sequence increment and loop increment within sequence are positive with frozen support
anatomy.shared_regime_threshold: at least two positive loops and positive regime-component contribution > 50% of supported positive regime payoff
anatomy.single_loop: one positive loop in same-regime episode
anatomy.stock_or_cohort_concentrated: top stock supplies more than 30% of positive contribution

coactivation_network.display_uncertainty_rule: observed coactivation exceeds the one-sided 95th percentile of the registered block-circular null

components.common: session median robust net payoff over supported eligible pairs
components.loop_excess: pair payoff minus common minus regime
components.regime: within-session-regime median of pair payoff minus common component

episode_definitions.adjacent: same or consecutive explicit trading-calendar sessions
episode_definitions.pair: existing frozen contiguous positive-plus-decaying pair episode ledger; positive session labels remain strictly positive only
episode_definitions.phase_rule: pre before onset; onset at first episode session; decay at final episode session when duration exceeds one; early is the first third; middle the second third; late the final third before decay; post after end
episode_definitions.same_regime: union overlapping or adjacent pair episodes with the same orientation/current regime
episode_definitions.shared_market: union overlapping or adjacent pair episodes across all orientations/current regimes

indicator_rules.atlas_population_rule: availability inventory only because its fixed-clock population does not identify the 2023/2025 h24 episode-panel rows
indicator_rules.clock_phase: use the frozen sequential checkpoint clock_phase only where opportunity identity joins exactly; otherwise unavailable
indicator_rules.coarse_bins: lower third, middle third, and upper third from fixed 1/3 and 2/3 within-period empirical quantiles; no threshold is promoted
indicator_rules.completed_prior_dwell: unavailable on the primary synchronized pair panel
indicator_rules.distribution_overlap: histogram intersection over ten equal-width bins spanning pooled finite values
indicator_rules.primary_matched_source: V2 causal feature panel joined on period-session-loop-orientation-h24
indicator_rules.same_orientation_repeat_count: unavailable on the primary synchronized pair panel
indicator_rules.standardised_effect: upper-third minus lower-third mean divided by pooled standard deviation
indicator_rules.state_age: unavailable on the primary synchronized pair panel; do not substitute post-anchor admission age

inputs.recovery_rule: Use only the retained hash-pinned immutable derived ledgers; never silently reconstruct an unavailable source field.

leader.definition: loop with highest complete-episode total positive payoff

nulls.pair_specific_independence: period-specific Poisson-binomial using each eligible pair's historical positive probability
nulls.primary_statistic: share of positive sessions containing at least two positive pairs

occurrence.mixed_history_within_identity: evaluate each decoded history length independently; a differing older state invalidates length three without discarding a unanimous available length-two path; never split one stock occurrence into several history occurrences
occurrence.primary_identity: period x session x loop x orientation x stock
occurrence.raw_fills_within_identity: one occurrence; payoff is the mean of capped fill payoffs

payoff.primary: one capped mean contribution per stock per session-loop-orientation, equal-stock ten-percent winsorised mean

primary_unit: period x session x current_regime x loop x orientation x registered_horizon
purpose: Describe the anatomy of temporary hindsight-profitable loop periods before any later prediction experiment.
registered_hypotheses: Temporary profitable loop periods are frequently shared economic episodes affecting several loop-regime pairs while one loop orientation captures a moderately dominant payoff share.
Dominance can arise from occurrence frequency, payoff per occurrence, or both, and those mechanisms must be separated.
Prior completed-regime sequence and state-history path may alter the payoff meaning of a loop orientation conditional on current regime.
State/history may explain common movement intensity while loop orientation explains leader-specific payoff excess.

sequence.bootstrap_p_value: two-sided empirical sign probability with plus-one correction; BH FDR uses this bootstrap p-value
sequence.bootstrap_seed_derivation: support.bootstrap_seed plus the first 32 bits of SHA256(period|loop|regime|sequence_length|sequence|contrast), modulo 2^32
sequence.clock_phase_role: predeclared descriptive context within each fixed sequence group; report availability and composition without adding clock phase to sequence identity
sequence.inference: within-period circular moving-session-block bootstrap over the union session calendar; all stock occurrences in a sampled session remain clustered
sequence.inference_support_rule: bootstrap intervals, p-values, q-values, and FDR labels exist only when target, other-sequence/same-loop, and other-loop/target-sequence groups all pass frozen support; unsupported inference remains unavailable
sequence.panel_mixed_history_rule: for each history length, every contributing stock occurrence must agree on one available token; any disagreement, unavailable contributor, or within-stock ambiguity makes that aggregate history and its availability flag unavailable
sequence.source: decoded frozen state_history_token using completed prior states only
